scripts.dev: npm run build -w @quick-filler/domain && concurrently -n domain,api,web -c yellow,blue,green "npm run dev -w @quick-filler/domain" "npm run dev -w @quick-filler/api" "npm run dev -w @quick-filler/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @quick-filler/domain && npm run build -w @quick-filler/api && npm run build -w @quick-filler/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @quick-filler/domain && npm run typecheck -w @quick-filler/api && npm run typecheck -w @quick-filler/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @quick-filler/domain && npm run test -w @quick-filler/domain && npm run test -w @quick-filler/api
